title: Induction heating of a thick copper slab under a uniform surface field (magnetic fields AC + heat, analytic)
description:
Planar magnetic_fields_ac + heat, 1D in x: an impressed current sheet (current_source H0 / w in air, x in [0, 0.5] mm) with symmetry on x_lo (H = 0 there) puts the tangential field amplitude H0 = 1e5 A/m on the face of a copper slab D = 10 mm thick (x in [1, 11] mm) by Ampere, whatever the slab does; magnetic insulation (A = 0, so J = 0) on its back face x_hi, symmetry y faces. magnetic_heat_induction hands q_eddy to heat (k = 400 W/(m K), T0 on x_hi; the air gap is insulated, so all the heat leaves through the back). Sweep f = 1 .. 20 kHz (delta = 2.09 .. 0.467 mm, D / delta = 4.8 .. 21).
Analytic (H = H0 cosh(gamma (D - s)) / cosh(gamma D), gamma = (1 + j) / delta, s the depth, real arithmetic): loss per face area P = H0^2 / (2 sigma delta) (sinh 2v - sin 2v) / (cosh 2v + cos 2v), v = D / delta (the half-space H0^2 / (2 sigma delta) within 2e-4: 41, 92, 184 kW/m^2 at 1, 5, 20 kHz); q(s) = H0^2 / (sigma delta^2) (cosh 2w - cos 2w) / (cosh 2v + cos 2v), w = (D - s) / delta; rise (theta' = 0 at the face, 0 at x_hi) theta(w) = C_q delta^2 / (4k) [2 - cosh 2w - cos 2w + 2w (sinh 2v - sin 2v)] with C_q the prefactor of q, at the face ~ P (D - delta / 2) / k = 0.92, 2.20, 4.50 K.
Derived values tab: B_gap (mu0 H0, exact), P_eddy (eddy_loss scalar = P h per m of length), Q_total (integral of heat Q: the transfer), dT_surface (max T - T0). Expect ~1e-3 at 20 kHz (second order in dx / delta, delta = 19 cells), less below; tolerance 3e-3.
Sweep tab: P_eddy and dT_surface vs f (~ sqrt(f)) with the dashed formulas.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 20 kHz): q_profile (magnetic q_eddy, exp(-2 s / delta) decay) and T_rise_profile (heat T_rise: linear conduction toward x_hi plus the curved skin layer; flat across the insulated air gap).

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: frequency in Hz (swept 1 .. 20 kHz)

parameters.name: H0
parameters.description: tangential surface field amplitude (peak) in A/m = sheet current per m of height

parameters.name: sigma_cu
parameters.description: copper conductivity in S/m

parameters.name: k_cu
parameters.description: copper thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: k_air
parameters.description: air thermal conductivity in W/(m K) (no source, insulated: carries no heat)

parameters.name: T0
parameters.description: back-face (x_hi) and reference temperature in K

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (440 x 4 cells)

parameters.name: h_y
parameters.description: window height (symmetry y faces: 1D in x)

parameters.name: w_sheet
parameters.description: current sheet thickness (air)

parameters.name: x_cu0
parameters.description: slab face (a cell edge)

parameters.name: D_cu
parameters.description: slab thickness D

parameters.name: x_cu1
parameters.description: slab back face = x_hi

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: skin depth sqrt(2 / (omega mu0 sigma)) in m

parameters.name: v_d
parameters.description: v = D / delta

parameters.name: den_v
parameters.description: cosh 2v + cos 2v = 2 |cosh(gamma D)|^2

parameters.name: S_v
parameters.description: sinh 2v - sin 2v

parameters.name: P_area_ref
parameters.description: analytic time-averaged loss per face area in W/m^2

parameters.name: C_q
parameters.description: loss density scale in W/m^3: q = C_q (cosh 2w - cos 2w)

parameters.name: theta_coef
parameters.description: temperature scale of the rise in K

parameters.name: theta_s_ref
parameters.description: analytic face (and air gap) rise in K

analytic_curves.name: q_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(x > x_cu0, C_q*(cosh(2*(x_cu1 - x)/delta) - cos(2*(x_cu1 - x)/delta)), 0)

analytic_curves.name: T_rise_profile
analytic_curves.expression: theta_coef*(2 - cosh(2*min(x_cu1 - x, D_cu)/delta) - cos(2*min(x_cu1 - x, D_cu)/delta) + 2*min(x_cu1 - x, D_cu)/delta*S_v)
